object_mapping.input: Finite p-group multiplication table with identity and explicit embedded subgroup element set
object_mapping.output: ell(G,H),actual chain witness,baseline comparison and conditional graph metadata
object_mapping.required_identity: Use embedding sets under the same group presentation;abstract subgroup isomorphism is not enough

additional_assumptions: Validate finite group axioms,subgroup closure,normal inclusions andcyclicquotients exactly
A cyclic p-power quotient counts once irrespective its order
If labeling loss=r_n,retain n>=0,finite p-local genuine spectra and unaudited theorem dependency;calculation returns ell only
hypothesis: 在固定小群的全部嵌入子群上，循环链算法与独立全链裁判逐项相同；至少一个已知控制中按子群抽象类型或log_p指数合并会造成错误元数据，而保留嵌入可区分。仅检验组合元数据正确性，不声称数值证实r_n=ell。
baseline: Conflated key(group,abstract subgroup type) andlog_p[G:H];compare older abelian quotientgenerator rank and elementaryquotient lowerbound whereavailable.
incremental_value: Metadata reliability and explicit witnesses may aid the existing graph. Known controls are already decidable with older theory;no incremental mathematical benefit assigned to2026sharpness without independent spectral evidence.

test_plan.fixtures: Initially bounded synthetic multiplication tables for C4,C2xC2,C4xC2,C2xC2xC2,D8 andorder27upperunitriangular F3 matrices;enumerate every subgroup. Freeze final exact fixture definitions in a separate experiment spec before execution.
test_plan.oracle: Shortest-path method with normal/cyclic tests versus independently organized exhaustive strict subgroup chains and coset quotient generator checks;known quotient controls and explicit relabeling invariance.
test_plan.success: All exact agreement and valid witnesses;at least one invalid-surrogate decision corrected. Newtheorem increment explicitly untested.
test_plan.failure: Any oracle mismatch,invalid witness,unhandledcyclicquotient orabsenceofdeclaredcollision;retain adverse evidence.

limits: 合成有限群元数据QA，无真实外部数据库用户、谱非零性裁判或2026新理论增益。小群可能全部落在历史已解决范围。完整谱系、人审与形式化证明缺失。
resource_envelope: Proposed standard-library exact small groups;120seconds,128MiB Python allocations;compressed payloads andsources;not run.
